title: Exclusive lock helper with stale takeover and cleanup on throw
prompt: Fix the module src/lock.mjs, which exports an async function withLock(file, fn, options). It takes an exclusive lock on file by creating the lock file with the exclusive flag, then awaits fn() and returns its result. The lock file must always be removed afterwards, including when fn throws, and the original error must still propagate to the caller. If the lock file already exists and its modification time is younger than options.staleMs (default 600000 milliseconds), reject with an Error whose code property is 'busy' without calling fn and leave the existing file untouched. If the existing lock file is older than options.staleMs, treat it as stale: remove it, take the lock, and run fn. Use only Node built-in modules and ES module syntax, and keep the export name withLock unchanged.
